facts.text: A cat chalked on the gate means a kind lady lives here.
facts.why: Hobo chalk marks are a real thing, but none of the sources I opened show a cat mark or a chalk sign in the film.
facts.fix: A mark on the gate tells a hungry man the cook won't turn him away.

vibe.verdict: One of the best in the set, with the window, bee tree, Big George and Sipsey all in the right places.
missing: Towanda! (Evelyn and the car park, 1980s side)

Evelyn in cellophane (the dinner for Ed)
